project.name: home:i-danos
project.title: DANOS on Debian 13
project.description:
A port of DANOS (Disaggregated Network Operating System) to Debian 13 trixie: kernel 6.12, DPDK 24.11, FRR 10.3.
The line taken is upstream-first — where Debian ships a package that does the job, the DANOS fork is retired rather than carried forward. Hardware-vendor support is out of scope. Release id 2608, branch i-danos/2608.
Packages disabled here are not failures; each carries its reason in its own description. Most are forks Debian has since overtaken, and the official DANOS OBS project did not build them either.
